title: Agent Evaluation Lab Implementation Spiral
objective: Implement a real-provider, deterministic, local agent evaluation surface against the frozen API contract, with persistent suites/runs and explicit trace linkage while preserving no-tools/no-jobs boundaries.

work_items.title: Freeze Evaluation Lab API/data/UI contract
deliverables: Explicit versioned DTOs, route contract, trace/persistence semantics and UI boundary
done_when: Concrete request/response fields and limits recorded
Provider and no-effect boundaries explicit
Contract hash materialized before consumers start

work_items.title: Implement backend store, live run endpoint and LocalTrace correlation
deliverables: Workspace-isolated suite/run persistence, deterministic evaluator, safe API and trace attributes, backend tests and operator documentation
done_when: API conforms to W01 contract
Model/provider IDs resolved server-side; no tools/jobs/workspace writes
Provider errors are explicit and traced without secret/body leakage
Focused tests pass against temporary storage and provider fixture

work_items.title: Implement Evaluation Lab UI and chat navigation
deliverables: Low-cognitive-load suite editor/review/run/results view, primary navigation, chat route and component tests
done_when: No provider call occurs before explicit Run
Shows provider call count and effective model before confirmation
Loading, empty, error, unavailability and run outcomes are explicit
No synthetic evidence/trace/Jaeger link is fabricated
UI build and focused tests pass

work_items.title: Independent adversarial verification
deliverables: Independent scope/security/trace/UX review with P0/P1/P2 and NOT_RUN boundary
done_when: Validate current-source diffs and evidence against W01 contract
Inspect provider failure, stale suite revision, malformed suite, trace unavailable, and fixture-vs-live labels
No implementation edits
State exactly which executable checks were rerun

work_items.title: Terminal goal gate and evidence index
deliverables: Final status, hashes and evidence index bound to candidate HEAD
done_when: All handoffs validate
No P0/P1 unresolved for claimed scope
Live inference evidence is separated from fixture tests
Any unrun Jaeger/lint/UI check is explicit
No commit or sync is claimed
